title: DINOv3
mechanism: Self-supervised ViT-7B with Gram anchoring that keeps dense features clean at scale, distilled into ViT-S to H+ and ConvNeXt T to L students.
adaptation: Backbone for VFM-H: ViT-L/16 (303M) at 1024 px, or ConvNeXt-L (198M) in smp U-Net++ with a stride-2 stem under PF at 20k steps. Weights are gated (licence click), need the user's OK.
min_experiment: Arm: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 in VFM-H, and ConvNeXt-L U-Net++ PF, 20k steps. Baseline: house PF. Metric: CV crack relF1@2, inactive IoU, E1 once. Kill: default line.
evidence: R (web, HF model cards): ViT-L/16 54.9 ADE20k (column order inferred by the search summary, check before citing); distilled family listed. Verified only via WebSearch, not Research MCP.
prior_overlap: partial: DINOv3 ConvNeXt-T under PF, 2 seeds, 4k steps, F51 crack AP: KILL (no sign of a gain). ViT-L, ConvNeXt-L, 1024 px and 20k steps untested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Default VFM for the Rein, Dino U-Net and dual-branch arms: ViT-L/16 at 1024 px; gated weights need the user's OK; DINOv2-L and C-RADIOv4 are fallbacks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Backbone arm inside VFM-H vs DINOv2-L; E1 relF1@2; drop if more than 0.02 below the best backbone.
